palette.primary: deep indigo and muted desert umber
palette.secondary: weathered sandstone, dusty rose, and subdued olive

texture: fine parchment grain blended with weathered desert stone; tactile but quiet
light: low raking dawn or late-evening light, with soft haze and controlled highlights
atmosphere: watchful, unsettled, prayerful, and gradually reconciliatory; tension without spectacle
ancient_world_principles: Genesis-era pastoral landscapes, tents, staffs, herds, travel gear, and plausible ancient Near Eastern garments
human scale and relational distance should carry emotion more than theatrical gestures
desert ridges, river crossings, encampments, and open sky may unify the parasha without fixing a single aliyah scene
avoid anachronistic military uniforms, royal architecture, and later religious iconography
composition_continuity: Use earthbound foregrounds, distant ridgelines, and directional light to suggest journey, encounter, and changed identity.
exclusions: aliyah-specific events or named figures as permanent profile data
